bom.justification: ESP32-DevKitC (ESP32-WROOM-32E) MCU driving the LED from GPIO4. Each GPIO is rated 20 mA recommended, 40 mA absolute; this design stays at or under 6.61 mA over every part tolerance.
Red LED, V_f 1.93 V at 4.97 mA on its fitted diode model (datasheet 1.7–2.4 V at 20 mA). A lower-V_f part in the same spread raises the current to 6.61 mA — still under its 25 mA rating.
243Ω, the E96 value nearest 5 mA. It sets I = (V_pin − V_f)/R1 ≈ 4.97 mA; halving it would roughly double the current and, past 20 mA, overload the pin.

100nF X7R bypass on U1's supply pin, placed close to it. It supplies the fast edges the rail's trace inductance cannot; without it switching noise couples into every line on the board. Rated 16 V against the 3.3 V rail.
